title: Rewrite of Title 19 county zoning code
summary: Planning staff briefed the Maui, Lānaʻi and Molokaʻi planning commissions on rewriting Title 19, the county zoning code, and said the first module of draft chapters should come to the commissions later this summer or fall. Staff said the County Council, not the commissions, has the final say on zoning code changes.
